findings.location: task.prompt[1].text: "Vamos a ver una película esta noche."; task.options[id=a].label: "Сьогодні ввечері ми збираємося подивитися фільм."
findings.description: The isolated sentence can announce a plan or suggest an activity. The key assumes an announcement, but no conversational context establishes that reading. The lesson itself explicitly teaches the alternative suggestion use.
findings.suggestion: Specify that the sentence answers a question about agreed evening plans, or supply an appropriate suggestion paraphrase and clarify which readings are accepted.

items.reviewerAnswer: a on the declarative plan reading. On the equally natural suggestion reading, 'Let's watch a film tonight', no option is an exact paraphrase.
sources: Packet lesson:A2-01-L5, content.body.steps[id=s3].blocks[2].text: "Vamos a + інфінітив буває ще й пропозицією «давайте»: ¡Vamos a comer! Що саме мається на увазі, видно з контексту."
Review instructions, Verdicts: uncertain, concerning keys that select one reading without sufficient context.
RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapter 28, uses of ir a + infinitive, including exhortative uses (from memory).

findings.location: task.options[id=a].label and task.hints[1].blocks[0].text: "Він уже вирішив переїхати до Валенсії."; task.feedback.incorrectUk: "Va a vivir en Valencia — план: брат уже вирішив переїхати."
findings.description: A deliberate move is a plausible inference from the prospective residence and new job, but the text does not establish his current residence or explicitly report his decision. 'Va a vivir' states prospective residence; it does not by itself entail 'has already decided to move'. The intended stronger reading needs context.
findings.suggestion: Use a literal answer such as "Він житиме у Валенсії й у понеділок почне там нову роботу." Alternatively, establish the relocation and decision in the contextual setup.

items.reviewerAnswer: The text says that he is going to live in Valencia and starts a new job there on Monday. Option a fits if a deliberate relocation is intended, but it adds information.
sources: Packet task:A2-01-L5-T36, task.prompt[1].text: "Mi hermano va a vivir en Valencia: el lunes empieza un trabajo nuevo allí."
Review instructions, Verdicts: uncertain, concerning acceptability that depends on unspecified context.
RAE/ASALE, Diccionario de la lengua española, entries vivir and mudar(se), distinguishing residence from a change of residence (from memory).
RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapter 28, prospective and intentional interpretations of ir a + infinitive (from memory).
